svg.title: Screen probes: a square direction map and a compacted ray list
svg.desc: A screen-space probe grid is reconstructed at pixels; each probe traces an equal-area square direction map and fallback stages run on a compacted list of remaining misses. Schematic; the real probe, PDF and trace buffers are captured separately.

g.text: Screen probes: a square direction map and a compacted ray list
The trace atlas keeps every probe; fallback reads only the compacted misses. A cell is a cone, not a blur.
Wp = ceil(W / D), Hp = ceil(H / D)
Default spacing D = 16 px; atlas = Wp × Ha
a jittered cell is a cone, not one exact direction
trace atlas · H = hit, M = miss
only !bHit lanes continue; hits stay in the atlas
PDF is a separate normalized buffer
Schematic. Real 8×8 trace directions and 6×6 irradiance maps are captured buffers; this diagram does not draw their stochastic samples.
